Exercise: Overhead Stretch

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
static

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- flexion
- external_rotation
- shoulder_abduction
- extension_of_the_spine

Primary Muscles:

- abdominals

Secondary Muscles:

- chest
- forearms
- lats
- triceps

Equipment:
None

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
low

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- relax_abdominal_muscles
- improve_spinal_flexibility

Contraindications:

- condition: recent or chronic back injury, description: This exercise may exacerbate existing conditions.
- condition: shoulder instability, description: May increase risk of shoulder dislocation or further injury.

Exercise Variations:
None

Substitution Options:

- name: Seated Spinal Stretch, id: Seated_Spinal_Stretch
- name: Cat-Cow Stretch, id: Cat_Cow_Stretch

Instructions:

- Standing straight up, lace your fingers together and open your palms to the ceiling. Keep your shoulders down as you extend your arms up.
- To create a full torso stretch, pull your tailbone down and stabilize your torso as you do this. Stretch the muscles on both the front and the back of the torso.
